summary: DXIL CodeGen crash (llvm::StoreInst::AssertOK / cast<X> incompatible type) construct-casting a single-element array member to a scalar, confirmed by the maintainer and reproducing on main and dxc_trunk; every stable release v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 fails this input (crash, or a self-caught 'Invalid record' at v1.5.2010 alone). SPIR-V still emits no diagnostic for the same array->scalar truncation (matches FXC); DXC's element-count check does fire for a 2-element array, so the 1-element case is a specific unchecked gap.
title: Can construct-cast an array type to non-array without compiler complaining (DXIL Crash)
